\begin{center}{\Large\textbf{TOY 105: Introduction to Invented Statistics}}\\[4pt]{\large Midterm Exam 1}\\[2pt]Fictional State University\end{center}
\vspace{6pt}
\noindent Name: \makebox[0.45\textwidth]{\hrulefill}\hfill NetID: \makebox[0.25\textwidth]{\hrulefill}\par\vspace{8pt}
\noindent Signature: \makebox[0.45\textwidth]{\hrulefill}\par\vspace{10pt}
\noindent\textbf{Instructions}
\begin{itemize}\setlength{\itemsep}{1pt}
\item Fill in the bubble of the single best answer for each question.
\item Calculators are permitted; phones must be turned off.
\item There is no penalty for guessing.
\end{itemize}
\vspace{6pt}\hrule\vspace{6pt}
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\textwidth}
\q{A fair toy die is rolled once. What is the chance of an even face?}
\opt{A}{1/6}\opt{B}{1/3}\opt{C}{1/2}\opt{D}{2/3}\opt{E}{5/6}
\q{The mean of 2, 4, 6, 8 is}
\opt{A}{4}\opt{B}{5}\opt{C}{6}\opt{D}{7}\opt{E}{20}
\q{Which value is a median of 1, 3, 9?}
\opt{A}{1}\opt{B}{3}\opt{C}{4.3}\opt{D}{9}\opt{E}{13}
\q{A sample of 10 invented widgets has 3 defects. The defect rate is}
\opt{A}{0.03}\opt{B}{0.1}\opt{C}{0.3}\opt{D}{3}\opt{E}{30}
\end{minipage}\hfill
\begin{minipage}[t]{0.48\textwidth}
\q{Two fair coins are tossed. The chance of two heads is}
\opt{A}{1/8}\opt{B}{1/4}\opt{C}{1/3}\opt{D}{1/2}\opt{E}{3/4}
\q{The range of 5, 7, 12 is}
\opt{A}{2}\opt{B}{5}\opt{C}{7}\opt{D}{12}\opt{E}{24}
\q{If P(A) = 0.4, then P(not A) is}
\opt{A}{0.04}\opt{B}{0.4}\opt{C}{0.6}\opt{D}{1.4}\opt{E}{2.5}
\q{The mode of 1, 2, 2, 5 is}
\opt{A}{1}\opt{B}{2}\opt{C}{2.5}\opt{D}{5}\opt{E}{10}
\end{minipage}
